literal_meaning: গোলাকার বা ঘনাকৃতির ছোট টুকরা (অনুকরণমূলক শব্দ)
example_sentences_in_english: Cut the potatoes into small plump pieces.
Prepare the vegetables by cutting them into compact chunks.
note: This idiom is commonly used in Bengali cooking to describe cutting ingredients into small, rounded chunks, reflecting everyday culinary practices.
